analysis.summary: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Limited reported its financial and operational results for Q1 FY22, highlighting growth in client base, disbursals, and assets under management despite challenges from the second wave of COVID-19. Management outlined forward-looking targets, including growing the topline by 40% and expanding the loan book to Rs. 11,000 Lacs by the end of the current fiscal. The company also detailed its ongoing investments in digital infrastructure and retail branch expansion, notably in Gujarat and Mumbai. Mangal Credit and Fincorp Limited announced its audited financial results for the fourth quarter and twelve months ended March 2021, reporting a net profit of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects the topline to grow by 40% by the end of FY22.
guidance.quote: Management expects the topline to grow by 40% by end of FY22.

guidance.claim: The company targets a loan book of Rs. 11000 Lacs by the end of the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: It remains focused to increase their loan book/POS upto Rs. 50,000 lacs by 2025, targeting a loan book of Rs. 11000 Lacs by end of current fiscal.

guidance.claim: Management expects Gold Loan Lending to grow by 150% in the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: Management remains committed to grow its flagship product ‘Gold Loan Lending’ and expects it to grow by 150% in current fiscal.

demand_outlook.claim: Individuals and businesses sought loans for survival and business continuity due to challenges from the second wave of COVID-19.
demand_outlook.quote: These challenging times have raised several concerns for viability of several businesses and families. This led to individuals and businesses seek loan for their survival and for continuing of their businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The challenging times brought a great uptrend in the growth of the Gold/Diamond Loan business.
demand_outlook.quote: The current challenging times have brought a great uptrend in the growth of our Gold/Diamond Loan business and we have further moved a step ahead in our expansion plan by setting up yet another retail branch in order to gain more market share.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the gold and diamond jewellery loan industry is expected to grow at a CAGR of about 13.4 per cent over FY 2020-2022.
demand_outlook.quote: We are likely to ride the gold and diamond jewellery loan industry wave which is expected to grow at a CAGR of about 13.4 per cent over FY 2020-2022 to reach about INR 4,50,000 crore in FY 2022, with NBFCs leading the way.

demand_outlook.claim: MCFL has strong plans and strategies to tap growing opportunities arising post Covid-19 period in securitized based personal loans.
demand_outlook.quote: We have strong plans and strategies to tap the growing opportunities arising post Covid19 period in securitized based personal loans, as large no. of small business and individuals would require capital to restart and resume operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its branch network into Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: It is expanding its branch network into Gujarat also.

capex_expansion.claim: MCFL has been spending on setting up a digital infrastructure to make the loan availing process hassle free.
capex_expansion.quote: MICFL has been spending on setting up a digital infrastructure to make the loan availing process hassle free and to gain a competitive edge.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans aggressive expansion to extend footprints through 10 more branches by the end of FY22.
capex_expansion.quote: These will be achieved by its aggressive expansion plans to expand its footprints through 10 more branches translating it to 1500+ clients by end of FY22.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced expansion plans of adding 5 more retail branches in areas of Mumbai and Thane.
capex_expansion.quote: the strong numbers have prompted us to come up with expansion plans of adding 5 more retail branches in areas of Mumbai and Thane with an aim to become a well-entrenched and dynamic players in this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 10 lacs in IT infrastructure to enhance credit monitoring and optimize operational efficiencies.
capex_expansion.quote: We have invested % °10 lacs in our IT infrastructure to enhance our credit monitoring and optimize operational efficiencies.
